verdicts.why: ਹੈ is the copula in 'ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ' (I need); a literal gloss 'have' for a word the English seed 'I need a little more time' does not render.
Seed has "won't be able to"; the row's "I'll be able to" is the affirmative form of the same words, with 'be able to' present but the contraction differs and 'I' sits elsewhere.
ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ is part of the LEGO 'I think that' in the seed; 'it seems' is a literal gloss the seed text does not render.
Seed has 'the best'; 'the most' is a literal gloss of ਸਭ ਤੋਂ, which the sentence renders only as part of 'best'.
ਕਰਨੀ is part of 'work hard' in the seed; 'to do' is a literal gloss of a verb the sentence renders as 'work'.
Row 'today' glosses ਅੱਜ inside the LEGO 'tonight', which is in the seed; the seed renders it as 'tonight'.
ਵੀ is part of ਕੁਝ ਵੀ => 'anything' in the seed; 'too' is a literal gloss of a particle the sentence does not render separately.
ਜਦੋਂ is part of the LEGO 'as soon as you want' in the seed; 'when' is a literal gloss not rendered as such.
ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ is part of the LEGO for 'nobody' in the seed 'No nobody told me'; 'anybody' is a literal gloss the seed does not render.
ਬਿੱਲੀ is part of 'the kitten' in the seed; 'cat' is a lemma/literal gloss of a word that is in the LEGO.
ਨਹੀਂ is part of 'nobody' in the seed 'No nobody told me'; 'not' is a literal gloss of a negation the sentence renders inside 'nobody'.
Seed has "didn't" and the row 'not' is the literal gloss of the negation contracted in 'didn't think'.
Seed has "couldn't imagine myself"; row 'not imagine myself' has the words but the negation is contracted into 'couldn't'.
Seed has "worrying about how you're going to pay"; row 'worrying about this' has the words but 'this' is a literal gloss of ਇਹ that the sentence does not render.
Seed 'That person you work with' has 'with' at the end and no 'whom'; the row is a literal gloss of the relative pronoun with preposition.
Seed has "isn't dry"; row 'not dry' has the same words but the negation is contracted into 'isn't'.
ਪਾਸੇ is part of ਖੱਬੇ ਪਾਸੇ => 'left' in the seed 'turn left'; 'side' is a literal gloss of a word the translation does not render separately.
Seed 'And along the main road.' has 'and' but 'too' is not rendered; the row is a discontiguous literal gloss of ਅਤੇ ... ਵੀ.
ਮੇਰਾ is part of the LEGO 'what I mean' in the seed; 'my' is a literal gloss of a possessive the sentence renders as 'I'.
Seed has 'as soon as you can'; row 'soon as possible' uses 'possible' for ਹੋ ਸਕੇ, which the sentence renders as 'you can'.
